description: How to reach one person: their email address, phone number where there is one, and their profile links. Give a name — add their employer if the name is a common one — and you get back the person, their current role, and the ways to contact them. Use it when someone says "how do I get hold of her", "find his email", "I need to reach the person who runs marketing there". Do not use it to find out WHO to contact: this looks up somebody you can already name. If the name matches more than one person you get the list of candidates and nothing is charged; pick one and ask again. Nothing is charged when nobody matches either. Costs 5 credits when it finds them.

company.description: Company name or domain — disambiguation hint.

name.description: Natural-language person name. Provide either name or person_id.
